title: refactor(rest): move registerAnalyticsEndpoints into analytics-routes.ts (#23050 slice 5)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 5 of the `rest-server.ts` split, by slice 1's pattern (landed note `6136102437`, steps 1–6), slice 2's getter refinement (`6189011700`) and slices 3–4's shape (PR #23670, PR #23705): the body of `RestServer#registerAnalyticsEndpoints` (one route, `POST {basePath}/analytics/dataset/query`, the semantic-layer dataset preview/query door) moves, unedited, to ONE new module, `packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts`. It is move-only: routes, the ordered registrations, every handler and the published `dist/*.d.ts` are byte-identical, and every reader whose reading included a moved line now reads it where it is, with its sum unchanged.

`rest-server.ts` goes from 11,495 to 11,042 lines (base `8c85141c5`). The card stays open for the later slices.

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved body reads**, from an AST walk of the method (TypeScript compiler API, base `8c85141c5`: JSDoc `:10249`, method `:10262`-`:10733`, body `:10263`-`:10732`):

| kind | member (reads) | class declaration |
|---|---|---|
| field | `routeManager` (1, its one `register` call) | `:2010`, private |
| field | `kernelManager` (2, inside `resolveService`) | `:2019`, private, not `readonly` |
| field | `analyticsServiceProvider` (2, inside `resolveService`) | `:2084`, private, not `readonly` |
| method | `resolveRequestEnvironmentId` (1), `resolveExecCtx` (1), `enforceAuth` (1), `resolveProtocol` (1), `translateMetaItem` (1) | private |

No bare `this`, no element access on `this`, and no `this`-rebinding function inside the body. Its module-level reads:

- **Imports still used elsewhere in `rest-server.ts`** (AST count outside the method): `GetMetaItemsRequest` (type), `classifiedRefusalAnswer`, `sandboxFaultAnswer`, `logError`, `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`. They stay there; the module imports the same names from the same modules.
- **Imports ONLY this body read** (zero uses outside the method): `INTERNAL_ERROR_MESSAGE`, `declaresServerFault`, `looksLikeInternalErrorLeak` (`@objectstack/types`), `stripReadDecorations` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`), `sandboxBusinessMessage`, `boundedDeclaredUserMessage`, `declaredServerFaultAnswer` (`./error-response.js`) and `datasetSelectionRefusal` (`./analytics-selection-door.js`, with its `[#17551]` comment). They moved with the body, as slice 3 moved `strandedDecisionDetails`; each left a pointer comment. Leaving them would fail `noUnusedLocals`.
- **One helper declared in `rest-server.ts`**: `mayReadPendingDrafts` (`:1825`, 4 other uses there). It is now `export`ed from where it lives and imported by the module: one declaration, never a copy. `src/index.ts` does not re-export it, so the published `.d.ts` is unchanged (measured below). `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts`'s bare-delegation pin still finds exactly one `FunctionDeclaration` with the same body.

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B):** the class keeps the private method with its name, docblock and position. Its body is now one host literal, `AnalyticsRouteHost` (each member typed `RestServer['m']`), plus `registerAnalyticsEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`. Methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`. The call site in `registerRoutes` is unchanged.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routeManager` | registration only (the one `register` call) | its one swap wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not this registrar | value |
| `kernelManager` | **request time** (`resolveService`) | not by the class (constructor only), but not `readonly` | **getter** |
| `analyticsServiceProvider` | **request time** (`resolveService`) | not by the class (constructor only), but not `readonly` | **getter** |

The getters are measured, not argued. A one-off vitest file (copied in, run, deleted) boots a source `RestServer`, drives the door, assigns the field on the instance AFTER `registerRoutes()`, and drives it again:

- this head: `analyticsServiceProvider` reads `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, then `200 {"rows":[{"region":"NA","revenue":1}],"fields":[]}`. `kernelManager` (scoped route, `environmentId: env_1`) reads `501`, then `200 {"rows":[{"env":"env_1"}],"fields":[]}`.
- by-value ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each getter in turn replaced by `X: this.X,`; anchor 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob `d5ddbc9d00` → `26f5c5f250` / `c19048589c`): the ablated door reads `501` then `501` (frozen at registration) while the other door still reads `200` (`Tests 1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, each run). Restored by the tool and a trap: blob `d5ddbc9d00` equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, the one-off file deleted. The path is source (relative import), so no `dist` leg applies.

**Mechanism hypotheses from the dispatch, measured:** (a) the body resolves the analytics service at request time through `resolveService`, which reads TWO fields: the environment kernel's `analytics` service via `kernelManager` first, then `analyticsServiceProvider` as the fallback. Both go as getters. (b) The request `ExecutionContext` is threaded through `resolveExecCtx`: one more forwarder, as slices 3–4 had. (c) **Falsified:** the body carries no `ADR-NNNN Dk` citation (`ADR-0021 D-C` sits in the method's JSDoc, which stays, and does not match the gate's digit pattern). `check-adr-anchors` reads 1761 decision-letter citations at base, at the move-only commit and at head, so no new anchor is needed.

| `meta-draft-read-door-census.test.ts` | 8 = 6 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 2 | the door's two switches (`body.previewDrafts`, `req.query?.preview === 'draft'`) moved; keys name the route, so no ledger row changed; length 5 → 6 |
| `rest-server-docblock-position.test.ts` | floors 4 + 3 + 3 + 8 + 3 = 21 | floor `analytics-routes.ts: 3` (header, host interface, function); `rest-server.ts` keeps 167 blocks (the body held none); length 5 → 6 |
| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 32 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 | mentions 97 → 101 (the seam: forwarder two, interface member two); forwarders 6 = (6 - 1) + `EXTRA_MOVED_REGISTRARS` 1, formula unchanged |
| `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts` / `ui-view-route-tenancy.measurement.test.ts` | `this.enforceAuth(` 53, `this.resolveExecCtx(` 68 over the list (52 / 67 before, +1 each for the forwarder); ownership guard 1 | length 5 → 6 |
| dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` (realtime tripwires) | 0 hits over the six files | length 5 → 6 |
| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`, `rest-server.ts` row | 70 / 19 / 51 unchanged; `this.routeManager.register(` 63 = 33 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 | new control `analytics-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` 1; `registrar list length` 6; `enforceAuth` 80 → 84 re-anchored (the seam: forwarder two, interface member two; no call site added) |

Each number above was also counted statically on the tree before the tests were re-pointed (`grep -oF` per file).

## Proof of move-only

- **`.d.ts`:** `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` built at base `8c85141c5` (this worktree, before any edit) and at the merge head `4ede7ba6c5` are byte-identical: sha256 `7489de84bc6feccb7cb1f28bcbe4a97775324959c61c9bfc35e8a8c45a6f3bc9` for all four files, `cmp` silent. The head bundles carry a head-only marker (`readAnalyticsServiceProvider`, 2 hits in each of `index.js` and `index.cjs`), so the declaration was rebuilt from the moved source, not replayed. ESM and CJS both load with 39 exports and one sorted export-name list (sha256 `84008c9643d55420…`, the reading slice 4 recorded). `AnalyticsRouteHost`, `analytics-routes` and `mayReadPendingDrafts` appear 0 times in the `.d.ts` and in neither bundle's export list; `src/index.ts` is untouched.
- **Routes:** a source `RestServer` on a recording mock server, with a protocol that answers every member, dumped under four configs at base and at head: `getRoutes()` (functions as arity), the ordered server registration calls, and a whitespace-free sha256 of every handler's source. **12 dumps of 12 are byte-identical.** default: routes `6931d1a5d182…`, calls `ccb3bd12f10b…`, handlers `6d4926ef1465…` (75 routes, 1 analytics); scoped-optional: `275c72f46c30…` / `339e8c3abc05…` / `92790e91927d…` (150, 2); scoped-required: `a2aa8183e213…` / `734f33133150…` / `f6e3fd853aea…` (75, 1); every-provider-set equals default. A second base run was identical to the first.
- **The handler digest can fail:** a positive control changed one character of the moved handler (`Analytics dataset query error:` → `!`, through `ablation-replace.mjs`): routes and calls unchanged, the handler list differed in exactly `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` (and its scoped twin in scoped-optional). Restored, blob `79b94357c4` equals `HEAD`.
- **Moved body:** base `rest-server.ts` lines 10263-10732, one 4-space indent removed, against `analytics-routes.ts` lines 88-557: `diff` exits 0 (470 lines). No moved line holds a multi-line string or template literal (both odd-backtick lines are comments), so re-indenting changes no runtime string.
- **Moved-line accounting:** `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change` base → move commit over the two files: 477 deleted and 483 added lines detected as moved. `rest-server.ts` is +28 / -481: the stub body (host literal plus `.call`), the slice-5 import and its comment, three import-pointer comments, and `export` on `mayReadPendingDrafts`.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` (a gate's target paths, `domain:spec`): `analytics-routes.ts` is discovered by the `*-routes.ts` convention and declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559, as the four earlier modules are, at its measured `stringError 0`, `siblingCode 1` (the undeclared-fault `{ code: 'ANALYTICS_QUERY_FAILED', error: outward }` arm, a computed `error`). `rest-server.ts` `siblingCode` 18 → 17; `stringError` stays 17. Sums 17 + 13 + 8 + 1 + 0 + 0 = 39 and 17 + 15 + 8 + 9 + 4 + 1 = 54, unchanged. Output differs from base only in those lines (15 → 16 modules, 6 → 7 ratcheted). `--self-test` green.
- The nine registrar-list readers above.
- Prose pointers that named `rest-server.ts` as the analytics door's home, in this lane: `error-response.ts` (the `classifiedRefusalAnswer` docblock; not in the published `.d.ts`), `analytics-dataset-refusal-envelope.test.ts` (the 1000-character `detail` cap) and `analytics-fault-user-message.test.ts` (arm ①).

**Red before the re-points**, each measured with the move in place (`60fb2f6d99`): the six `local` list readers read `Test Files 6 failed (6)`, `Tests 7 failed | 101 passed (108)` (five length pins, plus the docblock pin's length pin and its new module with no floor); `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts` (`repo`) `Tests 2 failed | 49 passed | 6 skipped (57)`; the dogfood pair `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)` (list length; the census row's `registrar list length` control). `check:route-envelope`: `analytics-routes.ts NOT DECLARED` (MODULES and EXPRESS_RESPONSE_MODULES) and `rest-server.ts` siblingCode 17 against declared 18.

## Readers examined and not re-pointed

- `check-adr-anchors`: 1761 decision-letter citations at base, move and head (hypothesis c above); `packages__rest__src__rest-server.ts.json` (ADR-0045, `filterAppForUser`) is unaffected.

No `rest-server.ts:NNNN` line citation falls in the moved range; `docs/qa/platform-checklist` has no anchor on the analytics door.
- Gate outputs, base `8c85141c5` vs head, identical: `check-system-context-census`, `check-single-authz-resolver`, `check-rest-log-declared`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:rest-log-spy-declared`, `check:platform-checklist`, `check-filter-alias-parity`, `check:liveness`. Identical except the scanned-file count (+1, the new module): `check-meta-type-normalized`, `check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary` (57 sites, 57 classified), `check:error-status-conformance` (463 producer sites), `check:doc-authoring`; `check-undeclared-dep-imports` +3 specifiers (the module's three package imports). `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` +5 file-level anchors (the new comments in `check-route-envelope.mjs`); `check-affected-docs` 23 → 24 route sources. The other differences come from `main`'s two merged commits (`check-durability-degradation-log-level`: one `objectql/src/plugin.ts` line shift; `check:cross-package-test-inputs`: +1 test file; `check:nul-bytes` and `check-adr-anchors`: new files).
